title: Measuring Gender Bias in Educational Videos: A Case Study on YouTube
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. The benchmark was designed to measure perceived gender bias in educational videos returned by YouTube's search algorithm for queries related to STEM and NON-STEM fields.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on gender bias.
references: Aslam, S., 2021. YouTube by the Numbers: Stats, Demographics & Fun Facts.
